name: codex-proxy
description: OpenAI-compatible local HTTP API proxy for Codex app-server over stdio JSON-RPC

scripts.test:caller: npm run build && CODEX_PROXY_CALLER_INTEGRATION=1 node --test dist/__tests__/caller.integration.test.js
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && CODEX_PROXY_CALLER_INTEGRATION=1 CODEX_PROXY_RESPONSES_INTEGRATION=1 node --test dist/__tests__/caller.integration.test.js dist/__tests__/responses.integration.test.js
